title: Urban GNSS Positioning
dek: Positioning in dense cities where satellite signals are blocked, reflected, or unreliable.
body: Dense buildings change which satellites are visible and how their signals arrive. This area studies measurement reliability before a position solution is trusted.
The current portfolio includes smartphone pseudorange reweighting and work on uncertainty in complex urban environments.
questions: How can an urban receiver identify unreliable satellite measurements?
How can building geometry inform a position estimate?
